reviews.comment: Charming lectures. He has beautiful slides and a calming voice/demeanour. He should get a raise for providing entertainment for the class. Professor spent time on CPU/GPU construction (fun). Exam 1 is easy, just review practice exam. For exam 2, make sure to know how to do some of the PQs (slightly easier than them).

Goated prof! Difficult class, but he explains concepts well. Accessible to reach outside of class and super approachable for questions, so I recommend attending office hours or emailing him if you're struggling. Exams are pretty difficult, but he creates PQs to help study for them. You do more hands-on learning in lab (shout out to Ahmad, great TA)

Dr.Merchant is hands down the BEST professor I have had at my time at A&M. He's a great teacher, his assignments are doable and clear, and his tests are very practical and not too difficult to do well on. The only reason I did bad in this class is because I did not do my homework on time. Homework is BY FAR the hardest part of the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hard class, but he curves the final grade heavily. Go to office hours if you need help, as his lectures aren't the best, but overall, 312 isn't an easy class no matter who you take. Make sure to review the PQs, as the exam is similar, and do well on the first exam, as that is the easiest.

Explained concepts VERY well. Made an A very achievable even though I'm not a CS-adjacent major. HWs are brutal tho. Use the full week in advance. Mandatory labs and surprise engagement quizzes in class. You get room to miss a few quizzes. Wants everyone to score well. Most people skip, but he loves when people attend. He wants to know his students

Amazing lectures, somewhat witty too. Weekly labs require attendance but are generally short. Homeworks can easily take hours---start them at least the day before it is due. Posts plenty of practice problems which are about the same difficulty as the exams, which are themselves alright.

Very sweet man and super approachable! Labs are also pretty free, just go to them for attendance points. Expect to do a LOT of learning on your own. The PQs and slides don't prepare you at all for the exams so that part sucked. I didn't go to class all semester, technically made a C but he curved the class at the end so I ended with a B. THE GOAT!

He was an excellent professor, class content can get boring at times but he gives great lectures, asks for questions, and does his best to get to know his students. He also provides lots of practice questions and engagement activities that are helpful for studying. The homework is standardized but takes hours so start early and use the PTs for help

Amazing Professor for capstone. We spent a lot of time choosing teams and refining project ideas, so most teams were pretty cohesive. Very little busy work. Your focus is your project. Weekly meetings are super helpful. Grading is very fair. Cannot recommend this man enough. Take his class.
He is nice and cares about the students. Was able to meet with students outside of class several times throughout the semester and is willing to work with students and their busy schedules.

Very caring professor. He has weekly meetings with each team which were very helpful. He is also great to talk to. He gave more lectures at the beginning of the semester but eventually attendance was no longer required and class became project time. He works with you to come up with your project. Take him for 483 if you can. Pretty funny, too.

I never really cared to show up to any lecture because him & his students would go off on a tangent unrelated to any of the material you need to know on the exams. Exams are short; Time and question quantity wise. Unless you fully understand each question you'll lose points everywhere. Labs were good though. Hope other sections are more worthwhile.

I have no issue with Merchant, he is a nice guy and passionate teacher. I have a huge issue with the exams. You are given many practice problems, then the exam is literally nothing like the practice problems. Really hard to prepare. The TA is awesome (Ahmed), Lab > Lecture. The first exam is easy and lures you into a false sense of hope.

Merchant knows his students well. He is well-organized and it made capstone so much easier. He sets his standards high, but he is very willing to help. He's also genuinely concerned with your well-being. He's funny and fun to talk to. He knows what life in the industry is actually like, and he teaches it well. Take advantage of the class!

Lectures were good I guess, but I didn't rally understand what was going on until I went to office hours. He explains things super well in a one-on-one setting but got a little distracted bouncing around a lecture room.

Dr. Merchant is a phenomenal professor for those with or without prior C++ experience. He gives very detailed lectures (moving slow enough for clarity), makes it a point to learn everyone's names, and is happy to answer questions or talk with you outside of class. HomeWorks will take forever no matter how good you are at C++ (use the TAs and PTs).
Makes lectures just interesting enough to stay engaged is funny some times.
Great lecturer and an overall amazing guy. The class itself isn't too hard if you have previous programming experience but get ready to spend a while on the homeworks.

This is a Cloud Computing class. Labs were using AWS and makes you learn practical concepts needed for the industry. Cloud plays a good part in today's AI world and Prof. Merchant's course is geared to it. He is a great professor.

This professor is amazing. He is so passionate about what he teaches and loves taking questions in class. He explains things really well. There is homework every week and it does take a lot of time, but it is worth it since it preps you well for exams. The lectures are very helpful and I don't really say that often abt other profs. Take him!!

Is always a great guy that teaches well and deliver engaging lectures. Everyone actually pays attention in class. And also Merchant knows a lot of non-academic stuff such as football, and how code gets actually deployed in industry rather than an academic setting.
GOAT, participate in class for maximum knowledge absorption.

Don't have any complaints, was all around a great professor. Lectures were clear. Assignments could be a pain but had unlimited attempts and were standardized. His exams were easier which was nice (don't slack though bc i bombed the final and barely kept my A). If you like to ask questions in class you will love Merchant and he will love you.

One of the most passionate profs in CS Explains the concepts really well. Gives a lot of practice problems which are helpful for the exam. If you are interested in low level stuff class will be easy. But course content is more or less dry and boring. Taking him helped in that aspect I had to spend little time outside class figuring things out.

Really a great professor. Learned a lot of the students names, has interesting lectures, and explains problems well. The class content itself won't differ between professors (minus lecture participation activities), but if you care about having good lectures and exam reviews then Merchant is what you want.

By far the best professor I have ever taken. I wish I could take him for every single class going forward. He is so caring and he makes sure to learn everyone's names. He understands that the homework's can be challenging and works hard to make sure we understand whats required. He does lots of reviews before exams. Not a bad bone in his body.

One of my favorites. Super passionate and engaging person who loves answering questions. Great office hours. Assignments were labs which weren't bad. Exams aren't too hard and he gives a ton of extra credit. If you actually pay attention to the lecture and do good on quizzes you will get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Such a nice professor. He genuinely cares to learn his students' names, and lectures are boring, but so is some of the content. This class is pretty easy as long as you do the homework and study a little bit for the exams, you'll do great. Also, make sure you go to the TAs for help with the homework, as they often came up clutch for me.

Professor Merchant is amazing and obvisouly cares about his students. He really wants his students to participate in class and does good exam reviews. The exams for this class arent bad but the hw can take a really long time. Going to the TA's for help with the hw is def really helpful. Would 100% take him again!!!

Prof for 120 doesn't matter, it's all the same curriculum for every professor. I'll give bro a 5 though because he's super wholesome & hilarious & caring. Lectures are lowkey boring but you can learn on your own. If you want to learn more about more complex stuff, he talked with me for an hour+ about program optimization. He's awesome to talk to.
Probably the kindest prof. Class is easy across the board and exams are common.

Please take this guy for CSE120. The coursework and labs are common among professors, but this guy is by far the best one of them all. His lectures are extremely well organized and he makes sure that his students understand every slide. Additionally, he is super friendly and approachable any time. Merchant is the goat

He's not only an incredible lecturer but also a genuinely great person. Amit is extremely caring toward his students and actively seeks feedback during class to make sure everyone is engaged and understanding the material. Easily one of the best professors in the CS department, and I'd absolutely take a class with him again.

The Big Merch is very caring for his students and seeks feedback during class to ensure that people are engaged and understanding the content. He was always willing to go more into depth after-class or office hours if you didn't understand the concepts or wanted to explore the topic more.

Very kind and approachable professor, and makes lectures pretty engaging. Likes to get to know his students. Makes 120 as easy / simple as possible. Would definitely take the Big Merch again, definitely one of the best professors in the CS department.
Absolutely phenomenal professor. Would take him again any day without a doubt. It is evident that he cares about his students and he makes it a point to learn all of his students' names.

Dr. Merchant was a new professor this semester and he was great. He spends plenty of time on subjects and thoroughly explains them, leaving ample time for questions. He is also a funny guy and it's entertaining to be in his class. Overall, HWs are common between classes and can take a while to do. Exams were not bad at all and its very easy to pass

I am so lucky that I got this professor for CSCE 120. He is extremely caring and wants all his students to succeed. In addition, he remembers his students names, and makes a genuine effort to improve his teaching.

If youre a CS/CE/DE Major 100% TAKE THIS PROF. Hes genuinely passionate about CS and it shows. Hes hella chill and makes a point to learn everyones name and make sure that everyone is comfortable enough to ask questions. If you're a different major still take this prof because his lectures are the BEST compared to others, and he's approachable asf.

Amazing prof. One of the best lecturers I've ever seen, genuinely cares about his students. Makes the content so easy to understand, constantly asks for feedback on the course, and does lots of examples. Felt very well prepared for all tests and finals. Very manageable A in an important foundational class with hard topics. Great teacher and person.
THE GOAT! Best prof ever. Actually knows what they're talking about and cares about all their students. Take him if you can!

Professor Merchant is hands down one of the best professors I have had at A&M so far. I'm an EE major and have no passion for C++ but I always look forwards to going to class, he's such a nice person and also a pretty good lecturer. Class is super HW heavy and takes a large time commitment but as long as you complete them, should be an easy B

I would put down my dog if it mean I could take this professor again, he truly cares about you and how you do in this class. He is always helping the class, really cares about your grade. Take this man if you want help in succeeding in the class. This man is the GOAT.

He was a great professor and very engaging. The coursework is pretty standardized for any professor you have for CSCE 120, but Merchant is super nice and will give great feedback! He's also super flexible about meeting outside of class.

Merchant is a wonderful lecturer and just a really good guy all around. He is also very beneficial to have a good relationship with. Asking questions in his class is very important even if they're really stupid and obvious don't be afraid he really appreciates when people pipe up no matter what. Just make sure to talk to him and you'll do great.

He cares about the development of his students and is very knowledgeable about this topic. I was able to email him and get a response back within 24 hours even on the weekends. I attended several office hours where he will reteach you or answer any questions you may have.  He also loves to talk about Aggie or professional football.

Overall amazing teacher, with excellent lectures and supporting materials to match, a professor that cares about his students on a personal level and will make the effort to get to know you and your name in order to better assist you with whatever it is you may want help with.

Overall, Merchant is a good prof, he's pretty active during lecture and attempts to clarify any questions during class about a topic and will take time on certain topics so that the majority understands. As an EE major who has no true love or prior knowledge for C++, he's a good prof and as long as you do majority of HWs you're guaranteed a B.

Dr. Merchant is an absolute gem of a professor; he always jokes with me and the lectures are extremely engaging and a great opportunity to learn. He provides tons of practice code to mess around with and gives practical applications and is always available to help. He would 100% be my first choice professor for any other class I take here.

Professor Merchant always makes sure you understand concepts fully, rather than just teaching you a method to follow. He is always very kind and happy to help, he is probably my favorite professor thus far. Whether you have a lot or no experience in C++, I would recommend his class fully!

Amazing professor! His lectures are engaging and he explains every topic really well. Whenever someone doesnt understand something he tried to explain it again in a different way. He is a professor of practice, so he knows the topics really well. I def recommend him and im taking him again for csce 312.
amazing prof, I would take another class by him if I could!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amit has gotta be the best cs proffesor i've ever had, honestly he's a great guy and loves being there. No problems with him.
great lad!
This guy is chill. Coursework in itself is bad but he cares about us. Make sure you don't skip class if you're in the front of the class or else he's gonna call you out but its all in jokes.

His lectures are amazing and you can see he genuinely puts efforts into his lectures and slides and comes up with interesting questions to ask the students. Instead of just teaching the syntax and its function, he goes one step beyond and also talks about the point of having it at all. He genuinely cares for his students and gives extra credit too!
